title: Give buyers of proposed lots a disclosure plan and statement
what: Before a buyer signs a contract for a proposed lot, give the buyer a disclosure plan and disclosure statement (or the approved plan of survey).

sources.title: Land Sales Act 1984 (Qld)
sources.quote: The seller of a proposed lot must give the proposed buyer of the lot, before the proposed buyer enters into a contract for the sale of the lot— (a) a disclosure plan and disclosure statement for the proposed lot

administration.who: Fair trading inspectors (Fair Trading Inspectors Act 2014, Qld)

sources.title: Land Sales Act 1984 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 5, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: inspector means a person who holds office under the FTI Act as an inspector for this Act.
